text: Coffee with Jess. Her interview at the council is next Tuesday and she's properly nervous, hasn't slept much. Gintaras is helping her prep answers this weekend. Text her Monday night to say good luck.

Long catch-up with Mai on the phone. Her dad's hip op went fine on Thursday, he's on a ward at the General until sometime next week. She's driving up and down every day and sounds shattered. Her brother Duc is flying in from Hanoi end of the month to give her a break.

Sean got made redundant, found out Friday. He's weirdly upbeat about it, says he wants to retrain as an electrician. Grace (his wife) is less sure. They've still got the mortgage. Should check in with him in a week or so.
Vera's mum passed away on Sunday. Funeral is probably early November, she'll let me know. She mentioned her mum loved lilies.
Agnieszka Nowak - final round with the bank tomorrow at 10. Two panel interviews back to back. Her partner Reza is taking the day off to drive her. Ask how it went tomorrow evening.

Bumped into Arturo at the shops. He and Ricardo have split up after nine years, Ricardo's moved out to his sister's. Arturo is keeping the flat and the dog, Bruno. He seemed okay but kept changing the subject.
Marta's knee surgery got cancelled again, the hospital rang this morning. No new date yet. She's fed up and in a lot of pain. Need to pop round with soup this week.
Fern starts at the hospice in a fortnight, admin role. Really pleased for her after months of applications.
Dalia had her scan results back yesterday, all clear. Her husband Tomás cried in the car park apparently. Send her flowers.
Lola's grandad died last week. Funeral is Friday at 2 in Leith. I'm going with Dana.

Call with Alessia. She's got three interviews lined up next week: Monday with an agency, Wednesday a design studio in Shoreditch, and Friday the one she actually wants at the BBC. Says she freezes up on video calls. Her flatmate Alfie has offered to run mock interviews with her this weekend. Remind me to message her Thursday night.
Aarav's off work for six weeks after his hernia op. He's bored out of his mind already. Loves cricket so maybe drop some books round.
Kieran's been rejected from the police application again, third time. Gutted. Said he might look at prison service instead.
Duc and Eilidh are moving to Glasgow end of the month. Eilidh got the job at the uni so they're going for it.
Amir's appointment with the cardiologist is sometime next week, he's not sure which day yet. His wife Aaliyah is worried sick but he's playing it down. Must ring him after.
Ahmed lost his job at the warehouse. Whole night shift gone. He's applying everywhere, doing a forklift course on Saturday. His kids are 6 and 9.
Aoife - interview Wednesday at Deloitte, second stage. Wants to know if anyone has done their case study. Ask Claire, she worked there.
Anan's surgery is on the 3rd. Wisdom teeth, all four. Not a big deal but he's dreading it.
Ben and Tariq have broken up. Ben told me at five a side. He's staying at his brother's for now. Tariq's apparently keeping the cat, Pickle.
Picked up my prescription, sorted the car tax. Dentist moved to next Thursday at 4.
Jess got the job! Starts on 1st December. She's buying everyone drinks Friday night at the Crown. Gintaras said she's been hinting about a nice leather work bag.
Grace's dad has been in hospital since Saturday with a chest infection. Probably out by the weekend. She's back and forth with her sister Vera.
Mrs Gonzalez next door had her cataract op this morning. Her son Ricardo is staying over tonight. Should knock tomorrow and see if she needs shopping.

Talked to Sean about his exit interview, it's on Monday. He's annoyed they're making him train his replacement. Gintaras thinks he should get legal advice about the redundancy pay. I said I'd send him the number of my union rep.

Marta's dad's funeral was lovely, lots of people. She's going back to work next Tuesday but only mornings for a bit. Grief counsellor at the GP sometime next week. Her husband Kieran is doing the school runs. Need to check in on her over the weekend.
Mai's interview with the NHS trust got postponed to early December. Annoying because she'd prepped so much.

Reza called. His mum had a fall and broke her wrist, she's having it pinned on Friday. He's flying out to Tehran tomorrow and back sometime next week, depending on how she is. Agnieszka is holding the fort with their kids. Ask Agnieszka if she needs anything while he's away.
Agnieszka's off sugar now, prediabetic. Took it really well. Also she's training for the Edinburgh half in May.
Fern and her partner Lola are having their first anniversary dinner Saturday, she's nervous about the restaurant because Lola's vegan. Recommended Holy Cow.
Alfie's dog Rolo had surgery on his leg yesterday. Vet says six weeks of crate rest. Alfie's not coping well with the howling. Message him at the weekend to see how Rolo's doing.

Dana had her redundancy consultation this morning. Second one. They've offered her a part time role or a payout, she has till end of the month to decide. Her boss is being awful about it. Leaning towards the payout and a long trip to Japan over the summer.
Tomás Reyes - going for a promotion to head of IT, interview Thursday. He's confident. Not much else new.
Remind me to get a card for Aarav's family. His grandmother died on Tuesday, she was 94.

Catch up with Eilidh after choir. Her brother Sam is in hospital, bad appendicitis, operated on last night. He's 19 and terrified. She's going in tomorrow after work. Eilidh herself has an interview for a lecturer post on Friday, totally forgot to mention it until the end. Don't forget to text her Friday morning.
Alessia didn't get the BBC job. Feedback was good though, they said to apply again in the spring.
Claire's wedding is off. She and Ahmed called it a day last month and she only just told people. She's moving back to her parents' in Cork over Christmas.
Kieran, aka Kez, starts his new job at the depot next Monday. Night shifts four on four off.
Note to self - book GP appointment for the back, ask about physio. Also sort the boiler service before end of the month.
Gintaras is having his knee scoped on Wednesday. His partner Mai is off all week to look after him. He's very into F1 so maybe a model car or the new season book. Ring him Thursday.
Amir's results came back fine, nothing sinister. He's relieved. Aaliyah's planning a little dinner for his 50th next Saturday.
Aoife got through to final round! Interview is in a fortnight, in person in London. Her mum Mrs Singh is going with her for moral support. She's worried about the presentation part.
Vera's been signed off with stress for two weeks. Struggling since her mum died. Her manager has been decent. I should invite her for a walk Sunday.
Ricardo's surgery got moved again, now sometime early January. Gallbladder. He's on a low fat diet till then and hates it.

Lunch with Arturo and Dalia. Dalia's applying for a master's in social work for next September, needs a reference by the 15th. Arturo is going to Lisbon at Easter for his cousin's wedding. Remind me to write Dalia's reference this weekend.
Ben's grandad's funeral was today. He gave the eulogy and held it together. Sounds like he wants a quiet weekend.
Sean's son Alfie is having grommets put in next Tuesday. Day surgery. Sean's more nervous than the kid.
Rang Duc about the job at the bakery. He didn't get it but they've put him on the reserve list. Says he's fine, honestly not bothered.
Tariq is starting a new course in counselling in January. Two evenings a week alongside work. He wants to work with bereaved kids eventually.
Grace has her mammogram follow up Tuesday morning. Didn't say much but I could tell she's anxious. Her husband Sean is taking her. Text her Tuesday afternoon.
Jess's cat Mango went missing last Thursday, still no sign. She's put posters up everywhere. Gintaras is helping her do a leaflet drop this weekend.
Mai and Duc are hosting a memorial for their grandmother on Sunday, the one-year. Lots of family flying in. Mai's stressed about cooking for forty. I'm doing the drinks.

Drinks with Ahmed, Anan and Reza. Ahmed has two interviews this week, Tuesday and Thursday, both logistics. Anan's back at work after the op, still a bit sore. Reza's mum is home now and recovering well. Next get together end of the month at Anan's.
Aaliyah has a hysterectomy booked for early March. Recovery is 8 weeks. She's not keen on talking about it so don't push. Her sister Agnieszka will stay with her the first fortnight.
Marta mentioned she'd love a decent coffee grinder. Birthday is the 22nd.
Fern's interview at the school went badly she thinks. Blanked on the safeguarding question. They'll let her know by Friday. Follow up with her Friday evening whatever happens.

Rough call with Tomás. His brother Ricardo died in an accident on Saturday. He's flying to Valencia tomorrow for the funeral, probably there till sometime next week. His girlfriend Lola is going with him. Must send something to the family - ask Lola for the address.
Dr Nakamura said the biopsy results should be back in ten days. Mum's appointment to go over them is the Friday after. I'm driving her.
Kieran's partner Eilidh is pregnant, due early June! Told me today at the leaving do.
Alessia's dad retired on Friday after 40 years on the buses. Big party at the social club. She's sorting a photo book for him.

Long chat with Claire after the funeral. She's thinking of going for the senior nurse post that came up on the ward, closing date end of the month. Her mum's been poorly too, waiting on an MRI. Her boyfriend Ben is being brilliant. Encourage her to apply, maybe help with her statement next week.
